hooks.text: 近战武器可格挡弹幕，远程武器则从距离外压制敌人
hooks.excerpt: Use melee weapons to block the enemy's barrage and use ranged weapons to subdue them from a distance.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 从10类200多种基因构筑协同效果，但强化越多越容易触发恶性基因惩罚
hooks.excerpt: Choose from over 200 powerful genes in 10 different categories and upgrade according to your preferences. Unlock powerful synergistic effects by gathering various types of enhancement genes. Watch out for malicious genes, a key element in this Roguelite that thrives on the blend of luck and skill. As you equip more enhancement genes, your chances of manifesting a malicious gene will increase. Be wary as you'll sustain harsh penalties if you fail to meet the requirements.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 穿梭未来搜集线索再返回过去，让被忽略的细节改写后续真相
hooks.excerpt: Travel through time and gather clues from the future, then return to the past to unravel the truth. Seemingly insignificant details overlooked in the past will deeply impact the future.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
